result.note: Mostly ongoing negotiations and denials; tested only the settled facts about the February 2026 interim pact and its unwinding.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the interim India-US trade pact of February 2026:
items: Under the pact, Washington offered an 18% tariff track for Indian exports.
The pact was unwound by a Supreme Court ruling in May 2026.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The Supreme Court ruling that unwound the pact came in March 2026, weeks after it was struck, not in May. In return for the 18% track, India was to lower trade barriers and buy more American goods. A temporary 10% tariff was due to lapse on 24 July 2026.
questions.source: The interim pact in February involved India lowering trade barriers and buying more American goods, while Washington offered an 18% tariff track for Indian exports (we covered it here).
